$$ \text{Deviation (\%)} = \left| \frac{\text{Today's Volume} - \text{7-Day Rolling Avg}}{\text{7-Day Rolling Avg}} \right| \times 100 $$
Computed using `float64` precision; intermediate values preserved without truncation. | | **Threshold Comparison** | Alert triggered **only if deviation > 3.75%** (strictly greater).

- 3.7500% → **not flagged**
- 3.7501% → **flagged** | | **Alert Payload (Slack)** | Includes:
- Date (UTC)
- Today’s volume
- 7-day rolling average
- Calculated deviation (%)
- Source: `user_activity_events` Kafka topic
- Alert timestamp (UTC) | | **Testing & Validation** | Unit tests include edge cases:
- ±3.75% exactly (should not trigger)
- 3.7499% (safe)
- 3.751% (trigger)
